title: Feasibility study to evaluate the LUKA concept for child-friendly preparation and support during MRI examinations
summary: Feasibility Study to Evaluate the LUKA Concept for Child-Friendly Preparation and Support During MRI Examinations
conditions: Patient information and anxiety reduction in children during MRI

interventions.name: Intervention Group 1: Preparation with LUKA; MRI monitoring via audio only, using the LUKA guided imagery exercise
Intervention Group 2: Preparation with LUKA; MRI support using the auditory and interactive LUKA guided imagery session.
Control group: Preparation according to hospital standards; MRI guidance provided only audibly using the LUKA guided imagery exercise.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- German-speaking children aged 5–12
- who are scheduled to undergo an MRI scan of the head and neck at Erlangen University Hospital
- who have no prior experience with MRI scans
Exclusion criteria:
- Emergency MRI scans
- Cognitive impairments that make it difficult to provide age-appropriate feedback
- Intolerance to VR applications, motion sickness, epilepsy, or other relevant neurological conditions
- Use of visual aids that cannot be worn during an MRI scan
